workflow.title: Refund auto-reply, urgent ticket alert and morning digest
workflow.goal: For open support tickets: send the standard refund reply to customers whose ticket mentions 'refund'; send urgent open tickets to zara@widgetly.app; send all other open tickets to zara in one morning digest; then verify every outgoing message in the outbox.

assumptions: Only tickets with status open are processed.
'Mentions refund' means the words 'refund' appear in the subject or body, ignoring case.
A refund ticket that is also urgent gets the refund reply and is also listed in the urgent alert to zara.
Urgent alert is one message to zara listing all urgent open tickets; the digest is one separate message to zara listing the other open tickets.
Tickets with no priority or a priority other than urgent count as 'everything else'.
The morning schedule is handled by whoever runs this flow each morning; the flow itself runs once per invocation.
Refund reply text is exactly the text supplied by the requester.
risks: Each outbound message asks a person for approval before it is sent when run live.
Refund replies go to real customers; a wrong match on 'refund' would send an unneeded reply.
Sends are non-idempotent, so a failed run may need manual checking of the outbox.
An urgent alert and a digest are sent to zara even when a list is empty, which may be noise.
successCriteria: Every open ticket mentioning 'refund' receives exactly one refund reply at its from address.
Urgent open tickets are listed in one message to zara@widgetly.app.
Other open tickets are listed in one digest message to zara@widgetly.app.
The outbox audit confirms recipients and message hashes for this run.
